column3: NKJV has “received us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “received you.”
NKJV has “Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Christ.”
NKJV includes “brethren,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
Close to the Greek; NKJV has the order “Jesus Christ” where the Greek reads “Christ Jesus.”
NKJV includes “I shall come to you,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “the blessing of the gospel of Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the blessing of Christ.”
